question: Madagascar is an island country in the _______ Ocean.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indian**__**.**

__
 
• **Madagascar** is an island country in the **Indian Ocean**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Madagascar** is the largest African island situated in the **Indian Ocean**, about 450 km (280 mi) east of the coast of Mozambique.
 
• The fourth-largest island in the world has been isolated for about 88 million years and many of its plants and animals are unique to the island.
 
• **Madagascar** consists of **three parallel longitudinal zones, the** **central plateau, the coastal strip in the east**, and the** zone of low plateaus and plains** in the west.
 
• **The Indian Ocean,** a body of saltwater covering approximately **one-fifth **of the total ocean area of the world.
 
• It is the smallest, geologically youngest, and physically most complex of the world’s three major oceans.
 
• **The Indian Ocean’s** average depth is 12,990 feet (3,960 meters), and its **deepest point**, in the **Sunda Deep of the Java Trench **off the southern coast of the island of Java (Indonesia), is 24,442 feet (7,450 meters).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Atlantic Ocean** is the **second-largest **of the world's oceans, with an area of about 106,460,000 km².

 
 
• It covers approximately 20 percent of Earth's surface and about 29 percent of its water surface area.
 
• It is known to separate the "Old World" from the "New World" in the European perception of the World.
 
 
 
• The **Arctic Ocean** is the **smallest and shallowest **of the world's five major oceans.
 
 
• It spans an area of approximately 14,060,000 km² and is also known as the **coldest of all the oceans.**
 
 
 
• **​**The** Pacific Ocean **is the largest and deepest of Earth's oceanic divisions.
 
 
• It extends from the Arctic Ocean in the north to the Southern Ocean in the south and is bounded by the continents of Asia and Australia in the west and the Americas in the east.
